_comment: Committed human decisions on duplicate clusters (ADR 0001, decision 3). merges: these legacy records are deliberately folded into one canonical even though they resolve to different OSM objects; canonical is an OSM short id, or canonicalRecord = 'wherever this record verifies to'. separate: assertions that these records must never share a canonical. The four June far-match decisions (Buenos Aires, Dubai, The Modern, Palos Verdes) are NOT here: those records are re-derived by the automated rules in scripts/osmMatch.ts.

merges.label: New York / us (same city: the old pin is the City of New York's former centre point, in Brooklyn; Nominatim's reverse geocoding skips the city level there)
Tokyo / jp (same city: both records are the 'Tokyo' search result at different times; the old pin sits in Chiyoda)

separate.label: Málaga / es (revoked merge, Nov 2026: the second record is a dropdown pick verified to Málaga province, a different place and tier from the city; it shows under 'also in this region')
